candidates.change_summary: Owner() now returns the zero address instead of the stored _owner, changing externally observable owner() return.
Removed the require that newOwner is non-zero, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to address(0) (zero address) without reverting.
Added an extra require that newOwner must equal the current owner, preventing normal ownership transfers (only allows no-op transfers to same owner).
Changed the onlyOwner check to compare against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering who is authorized to call transferOwnership.
Removed the owner check entirely from onlyOwner, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership.
